observations.body: The promise to David joins offspring, house, kingdom, and an established throne.
observations.label: A promised house, kingdom, and throne

observations.body: The passage places Human kingdom beside a promised house, kingdom, and throne.
observations.label: Human kingdom

payload.posture: Read 2 Samuel 7:10–18 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the promise to David joins offspring, house, kingdom, and an established throne. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: A promised house, kingdom, and throne
